- Discard-empty: `onRequestEndSession` is guarded by `endRequestInFlight`; the no-records branch emits `workout_session_end{via=discard_empty, exercise_count=0, set_count=0, duration from clock}` once after `deleteSession` returns and nothing when it throws — `discardEmpty_emitsSessionEnd_withZeroCounts_once` (two rapid requests → one `deleteSession` call, one event).
- `FocusInputState` carries `seedInput`/`edited` per Contracts; only `withFocusedText` sets `edited = true`; every seed path sets `seedInput` per Design step 4 with `edited = false`; `handleLogSet`/`handleSaveSet` pass `input = if (edited) TYPED else seedInput`; `handleCommitTarget` passes `COMMIT_TARGET` with `input` from `focusEditorSeed(...).source` mapped OWN→`UNCHANGED`, LAST_TIME→`PREFILL_LAST_TIME`, PREVIOUS_SET→`PREFILL_PREVIOUS_SET`, NONE→`DEFAULT` — `setInput_typedWhenEdited_elseSeedKind`, `commitTarget_logsActionCommitTarget_forAllFourSeedSources` (asserts all four emitted `input` values).
